title: Region request governance and SLA onboarding playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Playbook to triage and govern non-bug region availability and data residency requests from enterprise customers. Covers intake gating, eligibility checks, SLA mapping and tiering, failover/DR patterns, compliance handoffs (Legal/Security), cost/back-of-envelope estimation, and communication templates. Intended for PMs owning region onboarding and SEs handling enterprise requests; aims to reduce decision time from discovery to commitment and to standardize what constitutes an approvable region or residency exception.
acceptance_criteria: A documented intake checklist that can be used by Solutions Engineering to validate new residency requests in under 48 hours
SLA tier mapping matrix (latency, RTO, RPO) linked to product tiers and Dedicated/Private options
Clear RACI for approvals that includes Legal, Security, Infra, and Product with SLAs for each approver
A failover recommendation matrix (preferred regions, warm/warm vs warm/cold, automated fallback policy) for common enterprise topologies
Cost estimator template (monthly incremental run_rate) and a short-run implementation runway estimate (weeks)

decision_criteria: Compliance feasibility: can Security/Legal certify the proposed region for the customer classification?
Operational cost: does the incremental monthly run rate fit the pricing band for the customer tier?
Engineering effort & runway: can infra deliver the necessary features (autoscaling, cache isolation) within the requested timeline?
Customer strategic value: ARR, reference potential, and offensive/defensive market positioning
Risk profile: data sensitivity, regulatory exposure, and fallback complexity
communication_templates: Initial acknowledgement to customer: timeline expectations, intake ID, and list of information required
Approval/denial template with rationale and next steps (including pricing estimate and SLA tier offered)
Technical kickoff note to Infra/Eng/Security with a concise problem statement and links to artifacts
